The Kingdom of the Apes... Once human territory, it was taken
over by apes and gradually wasted away.
Where did the apes come from? How did they learn magic? Why
did they attack human territory? Many things remained unclear.
Was there anyone in the world who knew the truth?
After a desperate fight, Deathpolca's party emerged victorious over
the apes and gained control of the country. Little by little, humans
would return to the land they once ruled.
\#The Kingdom of the Apes falls to the demons.
